entries.76458749de7c00bb: This single-segment business manufactures and sells valves and equipment that control various gases, mainly energy gases such as LPG (liquefied petroleum gas) and LNG (liquefied natural gas). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,044 million, up 3.8% from the previous year. Manufacturing is handled by the Kofu Plant in Minami-Alps City, Yamanashi Prefecture, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 151.

entries.9381a79d559db435: These are steel valves and equipment, including liquid-level gauges, for LP gas storage facilities and LNG-related facilities. In addition to onshore facilities and onshore and marine transport facilities, this also includes valves for ships powered by LNG, valves that control medical oxygen and air, and valves used in fire-fighting equipment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,468 million.
